body.value: One row, one number: 16 of Contoso's physical shops have stopped trading — every closure ever recorded, with no limit on when it happened, each closed shop counted once. What the 16 does NOT include: the online store (excluded by the declared physical default, and it carries no close date so it could never have qualified); no narrowing to recent closures; no collapsing of re-let sites, so it counts closed PREMISES and a place that has had two shops close on it contributes twice; and no split between the 9 shops shut for good and the 7 closed for rebuilding, because the question drew none.

turns.did:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM contoso_served.dim_store
  WHERE
    location_code <> -1
)
SELECT
  'ceased - close_date is present' AS reading,
  COUNT(*) AS premises_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT location_code) AS distinct_sites,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN location_code IN (
        SELECT
          location_code
        FROM s
        WHERE
          close_date IS NULL
      )
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS rows_at_a_site_that_still_trades
FROM s
WHERE
  NOT close_date IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'shut for good - status Closed',
  COUNT(*),
  COUNT(DISTINCT location_code),
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN location_code IN (
        SELECT
          location_code
        FROM s
        WHERE
          close_date IS NULL
      )
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  )
FROM s
WHERE
  status_annotation = 'Closed'
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'restructured - status Restructured',
  COUNT(*),
  COUNT(DISTINCT location_code),
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN location_code IN (
        SELECT
          location_code
        FROM s
        WHERE
          close_date IS NULL
      )
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  )
FROM s
WHERE
  status_annotation = 'Restructured'
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'all physical premises rows - step 1 population',
  COUNT(*),
  COUNT(DISTINCT location_code),
  NULL
FROM s
